actual_summary.prior_monitor_attempt: One additional v1 actual failed due to the file-stat race; no scientific progress was returned and no prefix adopted. Both unused v1 grants were retired. Complete failure artifacts are preserved.
actual_summary.scope: Passive saved complete JSON equality joins and literal display decoding only; no mathematical replay or scientific module imports.

assessment: Parallel implementation, independent correspondence checks and bounded execution produced a concrete result: the compact representation gets these unchanged targets past the earlier memory failures.

The measured whole-case resource gate passed for three completed setup runs. The scientific comparison did not complete: the checker returned unknown for each grounded cluster batch, so the required admission gate correctly prevented all eighteen recipient arms from launching.

Twelve certified exclusions per target are now actual saved objects. They demonstrate checked failure encoding during setup; they do not establish useful graph pruning, faster search, receptor-family reuse or an advantage over the conventional controls.

All thirty-six target certificates exhaust the first-row guard. This demonstrates shallow feasibility exclusions and correct certificate plumbing; it is not yet the discovery of useful multiscale failure patterns.

Even this setup costs roughly two minutes per tiny target. Native compilation, model construction and independent reference checking together take about 93 to 103 seconds. This is not yet practical proof search.

The next bottleneck is the cost of admitting clusters through the Native checker. A successor must account for every admission attempt and retain the same candidate language, six arms, target bounds and independent proof checks. Raising the checker cap or treating unknown as accepted would change the experiment.

A separate first compact attempt was killed by a file-monitor race. It returned no scientific result. The narrow scanner successor and fresh grants were independently reviewed; the failed attempt and retired grants remain in the archive.
The full research program remains active: a universal Wang bridge, learned RL proposals, practical tilings, and arithmetic/Hilbert-geometry proofs still need separate evidence.

The batch cluster query spent 7.315949 seconds and reached its fixed one-billion Native micro-step allowance. Its 7 proposed instances remain unadmitted; zero usable instances were returned.

The actual tiny mechanism controls and all 28 synthetic compact-reference controls returned. Those controls do not replace the unreached recipient graph/search audits.

conclusion: The new runs returned exact target models and 36 certified exclusions within the fixed resource limits. All three then exhausted the Native step budget when checking grounded lemma batches. No recipient search ran, no new recipient proof was found, and no GCTS or RL advantage was measured.
